headline: Beat-and-raise quarter with margin gains, positive FCF
summary_short: NIQ delivered its fifth straight quarterly beat, growing revenue 8.0% to $1,124.2M and Adjusted EBITDA 21.9% to $261.9M with 270bps of margin expansion, while the GAAP net loss widened to $30.5M on a smaller FX gain even as Adjusted EPS swung to $0.27 from a year-ago loss.
summary_long: Revenue rose 8.0% (5.8% organic constant-currency) to $1,124.2M, led by 8.3% Americas OCC growth and continued Intelligence/Activation cross-sell; Adjusted EBITDA grew 21.9% to $261.9M as margin expanded 270bps to 23.3%. GAAP net loss widened to $30.5M (vs $2.7M) mainly because a $57.4M prior-year FX gain shrank to $0.7M, even as Adjusted net income swung to $78.7M and Adjusted EPS to $0.27 from a loss. Levered free cash flow improved $137.3M to $74.1M on higher Adjusted EBITDA, working-capital gains and lower interest expense following 2025 debt paydown. Cash rose to $416.6M; long-term debt eased to $3,448.7M. NIQ raised FY2026 guidance to 5.2%-5.6% OCC growth, 23.5%-23.9% Adjusted EBITDA margin and $245M-$255M free cash flow, and issued Q3 2026 guidance.
